components.name: Default Button

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
The quote is read like the instruction booklet of a printer kit. Each part is a numbered step: an orange numeral square, an isometric line drawing of the part, its name and fields, and its price at the margin. The last page is the total. The page is white, step panels are flat grey, and the only colour is one orange, spent on step numerals, the total plane and a few signals. It refuses the category default of a form with a rounded summary card.

The drawings are not decoration. Each is an isometric printed block whose layer lines follow layer height, whose top hatch follows infill, whose right face turns orange when the part is multicolor, and whose stacked copies follow quantity (up to three). They are inline SVG drawn in the same ink line as the type. No raster images exist in the build.

The interface is Spanish, mobile-first, and dense in the way a manual is dense: small calm facts, big numerals. It is built to stay readable from 320px to 1440px with no horizontal page scroll and 48px touch targets.
keyCharacteristics: White page, flat grey panels, no decorative borders, almost no shadow.
One orange (#ff5a1f) used only for numerals, the total and live signals; ink for everything that must be read.
One grotesk, heavy weight (800) for numbers and headings, tabular numerals everywhere.
Drawings and tab sizes carry data (layers, infill, colour, quantity, price share).
Left column of steps, right column sticky total on wide screens; fixed ink minibar on narrow ones.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks position (step number), result (total) and attention (warning, confirm). It never decorates headings, borders or backgrounds of ordinary panels.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Text on orange is ink (#1a1a1a). White on orange is not used.

rules.name: The Weight Is The Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Rank is made with weight 800 against 400 and with size, never with a second typeface or colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure that changes with input uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are colour fields, not objects. No drop shadows, no blur, no gradients except the hard-edged 4px orange cap on rail tabs.

dos: Do let drawings, tab heights and the total reflect the real inputs; any new visual must carry data.
Do keep ink text on orange and orange to numerals, the total, and signals.
Do keep 48px minimum targets and verify no horizontal overflow from 320px to 1440px.
Do use tabular numerals and weight 800 for figures.
Do keep copy in Spanish and keep focus as a 3px ink outline with 2px offset.
Do draw any new illustration as inline SVG in the 1.5px ink line language.
donts: Don't wrap steps or the total in bordered, shadowed or heavily rounded cards; panels are flat colour fields.
Don't add a second accent colour or use orange for ordinary borders and backgrounds.
Don't convey state by colour alone; the error red always comes with text.
Don't use raster images or icon fonts; the build has none.
